canonical.claimed_static_limit: In the weak-field, static, spherically symmetric limit, with phi sourced by the total covariant stress-energy tensor (no per-object fitted parameters), the metric potential is claimed to reduce to Phi(r) = -G_N M / r * [1 + a universal Yukawa-type correction whose amplitude and range are fixed by the background values of C, D, f and their derivatives, not by any property of the source]. The explicit PPN parameters (gamma, beta) and the correction amplitude/range implied by this limit have NOT been computed or checked against Solar-System bounds here; this is stated as unknown pending the "vacuum/Newtonian asymptotics and static convexity" and "GR and Solar-System controls" gates.
evasion_rationale: Matter coupling uses a single universal metric gtilde built only from phi and two universal functions C(phi), D(phi); no per-species, per-object, or per-environment parameter enters S_m, directly targeting prior rejections at universal minimal matter coupling.

phi is sourced by the total covariant stress-energy tensor through its own covariant field equation rather than by any fitted per-object quantity (no per-object core radius, threshold, or saturation scale appears anywhere in the action).

Degeneracy is stated as explicit machine-checkable algebraic equalities (A1 = -df/dX, A2 = df/dX, and A3=A4=A5=0) rather than a prose assertion that the equations of motion are second order, directly targeting prior rejections at higher-derivative degeneracy declaration.
All conditions are marked declared_unverified: this proposal does not claim the Hamiltonian analysis, Solar-System fit, or dof count have been confirmed by any completed gate.
canonical.expected_dof: Claimed 3 propagating degrees of freedom (2 tensor polarizations + 1 scalar) if and only if deg-A1-f and deg-A2-f hold identically for all (phi, X) and deg-beyond-terms-absent holds exactly. This dof count follows the standard Horndeski-subclass counting argument but a full ADM 3+1 Hamiltonian constraint analysis (primary/secondary constraints, absence of an extra Ostrogradski mode, ghost-free range of C(phi), D(phi)) has not been performed here and is left as an open, unverified step.
falsification_tests: Direct light-deflection and time-delay measurements at known impact parameter (Solar-System or laboratory analog scale) to extract PPN gamma and beta, compared against the static-limit prediction of this action.
Binary pulsar orbital period derivative from direct pulse-timing residuals, compared against the quadrupole-plus-scalar-radiation prediction of this action.
Laboratory torsion-balance and atom-interferometer equivalence-principle and fifth-force searches from sub-millimeter to Solar-System scales, testing the universal coupling functions C(phi), D(phi).
Rotation-curve comparison for nearby systems using only geometric, non-kinematic-model distance indicators (e.g. parallax or proper-motion based), compared against the static-limit potential Phi(r).

canonical.matter_metric: Single universal effective metric gtilde_mu_nu = C(phi) g_mu_nu + D(phi) d_mu(phi) d_nu(phi), with C and D depending only on the local scalar field value and its gradient invariant X, never on object mass, size, composition, or environment. Every matter species is minimally coupled to this same gtilde_mu_nu, satisfying a single universal matter metric by construction.
